title: Verify immutable release lineage and filtering integrity
status_note: Round 2 after back_to_worker (CORE-02-verify.json). Schema claim scoped to the fixture; G6 implemented (filtered rows selected on the Arrow table) and the verifier's two G6 strict-xfail markers removed with assertions unchanged; G7 and G8 added; G1 raised to high. Nothing published; no scientific release implied.
summary: Six synthetic 150-sample phase observations (one each passed, failed, missing, unchecked, invalid, plus a second pass with partial optional NaN; observation_id c1 is reused across recordings and sides) exercise the release builder end to end. Identity recording, whole-observation filtering by full identity, known-missing preservation, a ledger driven by the same assessment, overwrite and lock refusal, changed-input rejection, incomplete review evidence, and remote checksum handling all behave as the contract states. Defect: an export replaced between admission and hashing was released, with the manifest's admitted row count (900) describing a different file than its checksum (1800 rows). Fix: hash the input before admission so the existing post-read comparison rejects it. Round 2: the verifier showed filtered.parquet was a pandas re-encoding (types, schema metadata, NaN). The builder now keeps the Arrow table and writes table.take(sorted eligible positions), so the filtered export is a row selection of the full export.
changed_files: contributor_tools/build_dataset_release.py (round 1: input_hash moved before _admit_input; round 2: _filtered_rows returns sorted row positions, the Arrow table is kept and filtered.parquet is table.take(positions); filtered_rows count from num_rows)
tests/test_release_lineage_adversarial.py (new; 41 synthetic tests; round 2: schema comment scoped to the fixture's column types)
tests/test_release_lineage_verify.py (verifier's file; round 2: only the two CORE-02-G6 strict-xfail markers removed)
